page.overview:
Who is Billy Devore?

Louis "Billy" Devore (born 12 September 1910 and died 12 August 1985) was an American racecar driver who raced in seven Indianapolis 500 races between 1937 and 1948, finishing in the top ten on four occasions. He also tried, unsuccessfully, to qualify for the 1950 Indianapolis 500 and 1954 Indianapolis 500.

He is the son of Earl Devore, who also raced in the Indianapolis 500 in the 1920s.
